sections.finding: Explicitly prohibits robots, spiders, scrapers and other automated means of access for any purpose.
Protected eBay, user and third-party content reproduction/display requires prior express permission from the relevant rightsholder.
Catalog content permission described is for eBay listings; not an independent MuseBooks reuse grant.

decision.existingEvidence: Retained as historical source assertions, not proof of permission
decision.reason: Existing ebay-public-manual source is already disabled; this is a policy-evidence review, not a product list.
